book.name: LUKASI
book.title: NHALU GHWA MAHA PAGHUTYEKITWE NA LUKASI

content: Kuhyuka kwa Yesu
Mulinjubha lya ulongohi lya juma, malabhila putiputi, adala bhala akilutola luhumba lwa kunungila bhaalubhikite kala na bhakighenda kulindogholo.
Bhakilibhona lila liganga likulu liigubikite lindogholo libhilingihwa kala kuhuma mu lindogholo,
Peni paayingilite mu lindogholo bhakighubhona ng'obhe mmili ghwa Bambo Yesu.
Paabheghite mu kukangacha nhalo aghwo, kamu bhandu abhili bha ahwalite mapinda ghang'anyimite muno handa limuli lwa njahe, bhakiyima ugheghela nabho.
Bhala adala bhakiyingilwa lyogha munu na bhakihokama mbaka palutupi. Peni bhala bhandu bhakiaghombela, “Kiyaha niki mungunpalaha yunaubhumi paatama bhaahweghite?
Kabhegha ng'obhe apa kahyuka kala! Mughakulungwe ghala ghakaaghombilite pakabheghite na mwenga akwo Galilaya,
kukita, ‘Yikibhegha mbaka Mwana ghwa Mundu kakamuhwe mumabhoko gha bhandu bhanaulemwa, na ahakata, kabamangalilwe na linjubha lya ndatu kahyuke.’ ”
Kamu ndo bhakighakulungwa malagho ghabhaghombilitwe na Yesu.
Paabhuyite kuhuma akwo kulindogholo, bhakiaghombela bhala ahundwa kumi na moja na bhangi mihalo aywo hyoha.
Andumitumi bhaayeghite mihalu aywo akibhegha, Malia Magadalena
, Yoana na Malia maghwake Yakobu papamu na bhangi bhaalongoanite nabho.
Peni bhala bhaayihwite bhakihyubhalila ng'obhe, kiyaha malagho ghabhe ghakibhegha handa bhana uhila mahala.
Hata naha Petili kakiyinuka na kughenda kula kulindogholo. Pakahokamite ngati kalolekehe mula mulindogholo, kakiyibhona sanda ghweka. Naywo kakibhuya ukaya kunu pakikangacha ghala ghabwitukilite.
Mwanja ghwa kughenda Emau.
Mulinjubha alyo alyo, ahundwa abhili bha Yesu bhakibhegha mumwanja kughenda kukijiji kiikemwa lihina lyake Emau, yikibha Maili saba kuhuma Kuyelusalemu.
Bhakibha bhangughombana bhene kwa bhene kya ghala ghabwitukilite.
Pabhabheghite mukuyobhela, mwene Yesu kakiahikila na pakityanga papamu nabho.
Bhombe bhakimmona kwa meho ghabhe peni bhakimmanya chepa.
Yesu kakiakonya, “Ndo mihalo ghani ayi yimuyiyobhela kunu pamutyanga?” Bhombe bhakiyima, na bhakihyononeka muno.
Yumo ywabhe ywaankemite lihina lyake Kileopa, kakinkonya, “Yingubhonekana ghwenga ndo nhenja ghwa ghweka chako ghwanga kumanya ghala ghabwitukilite Yelusalemu mumanjubha agha?”

Yesu kakiakonya, “Mihalu yoki?” Bhombe bhakinnyanga, “Milando ya Yesu ghwa Kunasaleti. Mwene kakibha Mbuye ghwa Chapanga, na kakibhegha na makakala makulu mu malagho yake na ndendelo yake mu ulongolo ghwa Chapanga na anabhandu bhoha.
Andundame akulu na hilongohi bhetu bhakinbhuha na bhakinntosa kuhwegha, nabho bhakimmangalila mulupingika.
Twenga tukidumbila kukita mwene ndo nkombola ghwa Isilaeli. Peni hinu linjubha lya ndatu kuhuma paghabwitukilite agho.
Kangi, amoo bha adala bha kimati kyetu bhakitulilimuha munu. Bhakighenda kulindogholo lelo putiputi,
peni bhakighubhona ng'obhe mbhili ghwake. Na paabhuyite bhakilongela kukita bhakiabhona mahoka abhili bha Chapanga na abho bhakiaghombela kukita aywo Yesu kangutama.
Mbole amoo bha twenga bhakighenda kulindogholo na bhakibhona bhula bhula handa bhaalongilite bhala adala, Peni bhakimmona ng'obhe aywo Yesu.”
Mbole Yesu kakiaghombela, “Mwenga muna uhila mahala ghwa bhuli, na atopo ghwa myoyo ya kuhyubhalila ghala ghaalongilitwe na ambuye bha Chapanga!
Bhuli, yikinkwiliha ng'obhe Kilisito ywakahaghulitwe na Chapanga kumbamandwa kwakya naha na mbole kakayingile mu ukulu ghwake?”
Kakifwambulila mihalu hyoha yakya mwene mu Malembo ghanakung'anyima kutandila mu hitabho ya Musa na mbaka mambuye bha Chapanga bhoha.
Nabho pabhabheghite ugheghela na kijiji kya aghendite, Yesu kakibhegha handa kangupala kughendelela mumwanja ghwake.
Peni bhombe bhakinpembeleha muno katame papamu nabho, pakilongela, “Ghutame apa na twenga kiyaha ndo makimuhi na lubhindu linguyingila” Ndo kakiyingila mu kitutubhi na kakitama nabho.
Pakatamite kulyegha hilyo papamu nabho, kakitola lingate, kakilinonela, na kakilimetula na kakiapegha.
Kamu mehu ghabhe ghakihughulighwa, na bhakinmanya kukita ndo Yesu, peni mwene kamu kakibhuka mu bhene. Na bhakimmona kangi ng'obhe.
Bhakikonyana bhene kwa bhene, “Bhuli, mioyo yetu yikiyaka ng'obhe kwa uyelelo pala pakabheghite mu kulongela na twenga mu njila na kutuhunda malembo?”
Kamu bhakibhuka na bhakibhuya ku Yelusalemu. Bhakihika kwa bhala ahundwa kumi na moja na bhala bhabheghite papamu nabho, bhakikunganika
bhakiaghombela bhala ahundwa abhili, “Kulyaghila Bambo kahyuka, naywo kakinbwitukila Simoni.”
Mbole bhala ahundwa abhili nabho bhakiaghombela ghala ghabhabwitukilite mu njila na kyabhuli bhakinmanya Yesu pakalimetulite lingate.
Yesu kanguabwitukila ahundwa bhake
Pabhabheghite mukubhaghombela agho, mwene Yesu kakiyima pakati yabhe na kakiaghombela, “Ntame kya uhihimilo.”
Bhakililimuka na bhakiyoghopa na bhakihwacha kukita bhakighubhona nhuki.
Peni Yesu kakiakonya, “Kiyaha niki munguyoghopa? Kiyaha niki mmegha na bhwaghalili mumyoyo yenu?
Mughalole mabhoko na maghulu ghangu ndo mmanye kukita ndo nenga. Mughubyale mmili ghwangu kiyaha nhuki ghubhegha ng'obhe na mmili ebu kihupa handa pamumumona.”
Pakaghaghombite agha, kakiabhoneha mabhoko na maghulu ghake.
Bhakiyelelwa munu, kunu paakangacha mbaka bhakinhyubhalila ng'obhe kukita ghala ghaabhabhonite ndo hoto, ndo Yesu kakiakonya, “Mmegha na hilyo hyohele apa?”
Bhakinpegha kipalamande kya homba ghwa kubanika,
naywo kakikitola na kakilyegha mu ulongolo ghwabhe.
Mbole kakiaghombela, “Ayi ndo fwambulo ya ghala ghanibhaghombilite pangali na mwenga, kukita ghoha ghatyekitwe yakya nenga Mumalaghilo gha Musa, na ambuye bha Chapanga na Saburi mbaka ghatulukile.”
Ndo kakighahughula malango ghabhe ngati bhabheghe na makakala gha kughamanya malembo gha Chapanga.
Kakiaghombela, “Agha ndo ghaatyekitwe, Kilisito ywakahaghulitwe na Chapanga katabamandwa na linjubha lya ndatu katahyuka kuhuma kubhaahweghite.”
Kangi kwa lihina lya Yesu bhandu bha milima hyoha kutandila Yelusalemu bhaalandamihwa kukita bhalipetule ulemwa ghwabhe ngati Chapanga kabhalekekehe ulemwa ghwabhe.
Na mwenga ndo ayimiho bha mihalo ayi na yinguakwiliha kulandamiha ghoha ghamughabhonite.
“Nnole nenga ndanlaghila Nhuki ghwa Chapanga, ywene Tate kakilaghite kukita kataapegha. Peni nlindile apa pakitami mbaka pankingama lila likalama kuhuma kunani.”
Yesu kangughenda Kunani kwa Chapanga
Mbole ya kualongoha ahundwa bhake panje ya kitami mbaka ku Betania, kakiyinula mabhoko ghake kunani na kubhanonela.
Pakabheghite mu kuanonela kakialeka, kakitolwa kughenda kunani kwa Chapanga.
Mbole bhakichutamila mayughwa na kuntundamila na bhakibhuya Yelusalemu paakibhegha na uyelelo nkulu.
Bhakitama masaa ghoha Mukitutubhi kya Chapanga kunu paakintika Chapanga. Ayi mwika.
